# Button Group

Joins related buttons into one control. Outer corners stay rounded; inner borders collapse. Mixed inputs and nested groups are supported in code.

## Import

```tsx

  ButtonGroupText,
  buttonGroupVariants,
```

## Accessibility

- Behaviour and semantics are summarized above; keyboard and screen reader behaviour follow the WAI-ARIA pattern of the underlying primitive.
- `button-group.test.tsx` covers rendering, variants and interaction with Testing Library and runs axe-core on the rendered output (contrast is checked at token level). Every story also runs axe-core's default rule set in the Storybook browser tests; violations fail the run.
- Colors come from semantic tokens whose contrast is checked in both themes by `pnpm tokens:check`.
